name: bobnaley
summary: This EA opens long positions when the Moving Average is rising, price is above MA, and Stochastic is rising from below the oversold level. It opens short positions when the MA is falling, price is below MA, and Stochastic is declining from above the overbought level. Position sizing is dynamically calculated based on free margin with a maximum lot cap of 15.
summary_zh: 该EA在均线上升、价格高于均线且随机指标从超卖区域上升时开多仓；在均线下降、价格低于均线且随机指标从超买区域下降时开空仓。仓位大小根据可用保证金动态计算，最大手数上限为15手。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用均线与随机指标组合的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件：做多要求MA连续3根K线递增（maVal[0]<maVal[1]<maVal[2]表示索引0为最新值，但代码中maVal[0]<maVal[1]实际上表示MA下降，存在逻辑错误）、Ask价格高于MA最新值、随机指标从下方上升且主值低于超卖线30；做空要求MA连续3根递减、Bid价格低于MA、随机指标下降且主值高于超买线70。出场条件完全依赖固定止盈止损，做多止损为Ask-StopLoss、止盈为Ask+TakeProfit，做空反之。仓位管理使用Money_M()函数，根据账户可用保证金按公式（可用保证金/100000*50）计算手数，并限制在0.1至15手之间，根据手数大小进行不同精度的小数规范化。资金管理要求可用保证金大于5000才允许开仓，且仅允许同时持有一个品种的头寸。值得注意的是代码中存在明显逻辑错误：MA上升条件写成了maVal[0]<maVal[1]（实际是MA下降），与注释描述完全相反。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a combined Moving Average and Stochastic oscillator trend-following strategy. Entry conditions for longs require the MA to be consecutively rising over 3 bars, the Ask price above the current MA value, Stochastic rising and below the oversold level of 30. Entry for shorts requires MA consecutively declining, Bid below MA, and Stochastic declining above the overbought level of 70. However, there is a critical logic bug: the buy condition uses maVal[0]<maVal[1]<maVal[2], which actually checks for MA decreasing (since index 0 is the most recent value from CopyBuffer), contradicting the comment that says 'MA increases'. Exit relies entirely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels with no trailing stop or dynamic exit. Position sizing is calculated via Money_M() using free margin divided by 100000 multiplied by 50, clamped between 0.1 and 15 lots with variable decimal normalization. Money management requires at least 5000 in free margin and restricts to one position per symbol at a time. The StopLoss and TakeProfit input values appear to be in price units (0.0035 and 0.007) rather than points, which may cause issues depending on the symbol's price scale.

parameters.name: Lot
parameters.description: 手数（未使用，实际由Money_M()计算）
parameters.description_en: Lot size (unused; actual size computed by Money_M())

pros: 使用双重指标（MA+随机指标）过滤信号，减少假突破
动态仓位管理根据账户资金调整手数，有一定自适应能力
设有最大手数限制（15手）和最低保证金要求（5000），防止过度杠杆
仅允许单品种单持仓，避免同方向加仓风险
pros_en: Dual indicator filter (MA + Stochastic) reduces false breakout signals
Dynamic position sizing adapts lot size to account equity for some self-adaptation
Maximum lot cap (15) and minimum free margin requirement (5000) prevent excessive leverage
Single position per symbol restriction avoids pyramiding risk on the same direction
cons: MA方向判断存在严重逻辑错误：买入条件中maVal[0]<maVal[1]实际表示MA下降而非上升，与策略意图完全相反
StopLoss和TakeProfit使用价格单位而非点数，在不同报价精度品种上可能失效
输入参数Lot=5完全未使用，Money_M()函数覆盖了手动设置，造成用户误解
缺少新K线检测，每个tick都可能触发信号判断，存在重复开仓隐患
未检查交易执行结果，PositionOpen返回值被忽略
止盈止损值硬编码为绝对价格偏移，未根据ATR或波动率动态调整
cons_en: Critical logic bug in MA direction check: maVal[0]<maVal[1] actually means MA is declining not rising, completely reversing the intended strategy logic
StopLoss and TakeProfit use price units instead of points, which may fail on symbols with different quote precision
The Lot input parameter (5) is completely unused as Money_M() overrides it, misleading the user
No new bar detection means signal logic runs every tick, risking redundant trade attempts
Trade execution result from PositionOpen is not checked, so failed orders go unnoticed
Fixed SL/TP values without ATR or volatility-based dynamic adjustment limit adaptability across instruments
improvements: 修复MA方向判断逻辑错误：买入条件应改为maVal[0]>maVal[1]&&maVal[1]>maVal[2]，卖出条件改为maVal[0]<maVal[1]&&maVal[1]<maVal[2]
将止盈止损改为点数单位并使用NormalizeDouble与品种点值适配，或改用ATR动态计算
添加新K线检测机制（如比较当前与上一根K线时间），避免每个tick重复计算和尝试开仓
检查PositionOpen返回值并处理交易失败情况，移除未使用的Lot输入参数或将其整合到资金管理逻辑中
improvements_en: Fix the MA direction logic bug: buy condition should use maVal[0]>maVal[1]&&maVal[1]>maVal[2], sell condition should use maVal[0]<maVal[1]&&maVal[1]<maVal[2]
Convert SL/TP to point-based units with symbol tick size normalization, or use ATR-based dynamic calculation
Add new bar detection (e.g. compare current vs previous bar time) to avoid redundant per-tick signal evaluation and trade attempts
Check PositionOpen return value and handle trade failures, remove the unused Lot input parameter or integrate it into money management logic

risk_points: MA方向判断逻辑与策略意图完全相反，可能导致逆势开仓，在上涨趋势中做空、下跌趋势中做多
止盈止损使用价格绝对值而非点数，在5位数报价或不同品种上可能产生极小或极大的实际止损范围
每tick执行信号判断而无新K线过滤，在快速行情中可能因PositionSelect判断延迟导致重复开仓
未检查交易执行结果，止损止盈设置可能因无效价格被服务器拒绝而无法成交
risk_points_en: MA direction logic is reversed from strategy intent, potentially causing counter-trend entries: shorting in uptrends and buying in downtrends
SL/TP using absolute price values instead of points may produce extremely small or large stop ranges on 5-digit quotes or different instruments
Per-tick signal evaluation without new bar filtering could lead to duplicate position attempts during fast market moves due to PositionSelect latency
Unchecked trade execution results mean SL/TP levels rejected by the server would silently fail, leaving positions unprotected
